Description: Bank hold controller shall drive aileron from phi_cmd - phi error
Bank error shall be computed as phi_cmd minus phi at Sum_phi
Aileron command shall be saturated to plus/minus 25 degrees
Pitch hold controller shall drive elevator from theta_cmd - theta error
Pitch error shall be computed as theta_cmd minus theta at Sum_theta
Elevator command shall be saturated to plus/minus 25 degrees
Airspeed hold controller shall drive throttle from V_cmd - V error
Airspeed error shall be computed as V_cmd minus V at Sum_V
Throttle command shall be saturated to the range 0 to 1
Aileron actuator dynamics shall be modelled as a first-order lag 1/(0.05s+1)
Elevator actuator dynamics shall be modelled as a first-order lag 1/(0.05s+1)
Root inport phi_cmd shall accept commanded bank angle in radians
Root inport theta_cmd shall accept commanded pitch angle in radians
Root inport V_cmd shall accept commanded airspeed in metres per second
Root outport delta_a_out shall expose the aileron command in radians
Root outport delta_e_out shall expose the elevator command in radians
Root outport delta_t_out shall expose the throttle command in the range 0 to 1
